name: Play
description: Play is a ransomware group that emerged in 2022, employing a double extortion model and presenting itself as a 'closed group' that 'guarantees the secrecy of deals.' The group targets organizations across critical sectors including government, manufacturing, and professional services. FBI and CISA issued a joint advisory in 2023 citing Play's use of Cobalt Strike and living-off-the-land techniques.

sources.title: New Ransom Payment Schemes Target Executives — Krebs on Security
